ffg-star-wars-enhancements.respec.guide-: This window runs the optional REspec rules for the characters your players are playing. Read this once, then use the cards below.

Pull of the Force: roll one d100 for the whole table. If a character's Pull score is higher than that roll, their first Force power this encounter gains one Boost. Lower gains one Setback. A tie gains both. Mark spent after they use it. New encounter lets them use it again. The same number can be used for Obligation or Duty.

Force Presence: each character has ten points, and each point is light, neutral, or dark. Tranquility and Conflict are counted this session only. End session moves one point toward whichever of those two is higher, then clears both. Apply thresholds when someone is far enough to the light or the dark that strain, wounds, or destiny should change.
Fear: after a fear check, click the symbol that came up. Threat adds 1 Conflict. Despair adds 2 Conflict. Advantage adds 1 Tranquility. Triumph adds 2 Tranquility.
Morality is the score already on the character sheet. Conflict is what they have gained since it was last reset.
End session settles Force Presence. The tables are lists you read from when awarding Tranquility, Conflict, or looking up a career power. They do not change the character by themselves.
